newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Hanwha Group unveils expansion plan.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Hanwha Group unveils expansion plan.

text.p: South Korea's Hanwha Group said on Tuesday it planned to expand its business operations into semiconductor production and overseas farming from its current core sectors of oil refining, petrochemical and construction.
The group is currently one of South Korea's top 10 conglomerates.
Hanwha Group's spokesman Yoon Suk-jun said it would expand into the production of non-memory semiconductors by investing about five trillion won by the year 2000.
But he said further details on the scale of the investment would be decided later.
Hanwha Group has currently 25 member firms. Its core unit is Hanwha Co, which is engaged in construction, foreign trading and production of explosives.
Other member firms include oil refiner Hanwha Energy and petrochemical maker Hanwha Chemical.
